measured_change_10_or_more.rule: the problem itself cost an honest submission 10 or more points out of 100, measured on our test submission or a real agent run: in one submission's score, between two honest submissions that differ only in an unstated convention (Arc, Borden; the checker is unchanged), or in the score a run keeps (Order Addition). Computed limits, and changes that come from a fix's new 0–100 scale, do not count

not_counted.college_english_exam_bank: credit given to broken work (an empty grading report scored 100), not points lost by honest work; shown in the chart, not counted
not_counted.ffmpeg_swscale_reimplementation: credit given to unfinished work (up to 18.93), not points lost by honest work; shown in the chart, not counted
not_counted.integer_compression_codec: the −29.68 comes from the fixed task's new 0–100 scale, not from the problem: every submission's raw result rose 1.7–4× under the fix
not_counted.exchange_core_throughput: broken engines scored 4.71–24.40 instead of 0, but these speeds are within run-to-run noise (the side-by-side run gave 7.77 and about 4.7)
not_counted.dabic_gravity_inversion: the 48.06 (at C = 30; it grows with C) is computed from the grader's penalty rule, not measured; the measured change is 1.04

real_run.run: third-party Claude Opus 5.5, one four-hour run per task (huggingface.co/datasets/adafadaq/edgebench-opus-5-5-xhigh-rollouts)
real_run.kept_score: original and fixed checker, both regraded on our machines (mean over the gradings)

leaderboard.rounding: outward to 2 decimals, as in IMPACT.md
leaderboard.sentence_en: On the published leaderboard, Opus 4.8 leads GPT-5.5 by 1.1 points (44.2 against 43.1). The corrections that can be computed from the public averages keep that order (45.92–46.05 against 44.73–44.86). Adding the per-task limits we documented widens the ranges to 45.49–47.30 and 44.30–46.35. These overlap, so the public data can no longer confirm which of the two is ahead. This does not show that they change places; deciding that needs the original submissions or new runs. These ranges count the 19 effects whose size on the leaderboard is unknown as zero.
leaderboard.sentence_zh: 在已公布的排行榜上，Opus 4.8 以 1.1 分领先 GPT-5.5（44.2 对 43.1）。仅用公开平均分即可计算的修正保持这一顺序（45.92–46.05 对 44.73–44.86）。加入我们记录的各任务上限后，区间扩大到 45.49–47.30 和 44.30–46.35，两者重叠，因此仅凭公开数据已无法确认两者中哪个领先。这并不表明两者名次互换；要判定这一点，需要原始提交或重新运行。这些区间把 19 个在排行榜上大小未知的影响计为零。
